text:
anna: Quick update from runtime — pushed the e2e pipeline perf changes to canary this morning. TL;DR: p50 latency -12%, p95 -18%, infra cost per 1M tokens ~ -29% :tada:

samir: Nice! which changes drove that most?

anna: A few things combined: preemptive microbatching for short requests, an adaptive LRU prefix cache, and a small kernel-picker heuristic that prefers quantized GEMM paths for short sequences. Also a tiny scheduling tweak to reduce RPC fanout when batching.

liya: Any numbers from the canary run?

deploy-bot: Canary run summary (canary-id: canary-2026-06-05-01) — 100k requests, mix of chat+completion load. Metrics snapshot: p50 42ms -> 37ms, p95 210ms -> 172ms, token cost 0.71 -> 0.50 USD per 1k tokens (projected) — full logs/graphs: https://internal.redwood/perf/canary-2026-06-05-01

anna: Posting the config tweak we rolled:

```
batcher:
  mode: preemptive
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  batch_timeout_ms: 8
cache:
  prefix_policy: lru_adaptive
  ttl_ms: 60000
kernel_picker:
  prefer_quantized_small_seq: true
  min_seq_for_float_fallback: 1024
```

marc: Great. Any regressions observed?

anna: No customer-facing regressions in the canary. We did see slightly higher CPU on the host when cache churn is extreme, but it's within headroom. For seq > 1024 we automatically fall back to float path to avoid quality regressions.

liya: How's rollout planned?

anna: Progressive rollout: 5% -> 25% (overnight) -> 100% over 48h, with automated rollback if p95 increases by >5% or error rate spike >0.2%. Canary already passed the smoke checks.

ryan: Can you add the new perf thresholds to the alerting runbook? @eng-sre

anna: Yep, I'll open the PR for alert thresholds and the runbook after this thread.

ops-bot: Billing projection update: if this holds across fleet, we estimate monthly infra token spend down ~26-32% for mid-tier workloads. Adding note to cost-dashboard.

samir: Awesome work. Can we get a short blurb for the all-hands tomorrow? Ops/cost wins are good to share.

anna: Will draft a 2-slide summary (numbers + what changed) and ping marketing for a short note.

marc: Also please add a short note about the kernel-picker heuristic in the model-onboarding checklist so model owners are aware.

anna: Done. I'll also post a short writeup in #docs with the config snippet and the canary link.

liya: :thumbsup: thanks for shipping this so cleanly.

ryan: Let's schedule a quick retro next week to capture learnings and potential follow-ups (cache TTL tuning, finer-grained kernel heuristics).

anna: Sounds good — I'll set up a 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary -> rollout started at 1778501300, current rollout 5% traffic. Monitoring enabled.

ops-bot: Noted in cost-savings tracker (ref: COST-2026-06-E2E).

anna: Closing thread — will update once 25% step completes or if any alerts fire.
